question: Who Owns Wendy's?
quick_answer: Wendy's is a publicly traded company, formally The Wendy's Company, listed on the NASDAQ under the ticker WEN, so it is owned by its shareholders. It was founded in 1969 by Dave Thomas in Columbus, Ohio. The investment firm Trian Partners, led by Nelson Peltz, has long been its largest shareholder.

body.heading: Who owns Wendy's?
body.text: Wendy's is a public company known as The Wendy's Company, trading on the NASDAQ under the ticker WEN. That means it is owned by its shareholders rather than a single parent company. It is run by its own management team and board of directors.

body.heading: The founder, Dave Thomas
body.text: Wendy's was founded in 1969 by Dave Thomas in Columbus, Ohio, and named after his daughter. Thomas became the face of the brand for years through its advertising. The company grew into one of the largest burger chains in the US.

body.heading: A major shareholder
body.text: The investment firm Trian Partners, led by Nelson Peltz, has long been the biggest shareholder in Wendy's and has had significant influence on the company. Even so, as a public company Wendy's is owned broadly by its shareholders, not by any one person outright.
